text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to obtain approval to extend the existing 40 km/h speed limit on Allanhurst Drive between Royal York Road and Edenbridge Drive further west to Edenvale Crescent (West Intersection) to provide a more uniform and continuous speed limit on the street.
Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Allanhurst Drive, between Royal York Road and Edenvale Crescent (West Intersection).
